items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: He introduced me to Buddy Tate.

ctx.x: Where did you meet the Lion?
Out on Broadway. [CHUCKLES] He introduced me to Buddy Tate. He introduced me to everybody. He used to take me around with him just like a dog.

And Tatum did the same thing. Tatum liked me, and he used to take me around. He used to have his chauffeur come pick me up where I was working, and then we'd come and we'd get Art, and then we'd go out and play all night. That's where I overcame my fear of playing in front of someone who was exceptionally much greater than I am. He just told me, he just said, "Just play what you play. Play... Be yourself. Play." He says, "I like it. I don't care who else likes it. Play! If you don't play, I will play." He said,…
